title: A MESSAGE FROM #ANDREW THE #MARTYR
segments: as I reflect on my journey as an apostle
I am reminded of the immense trials I
faced with the ultimate sacrifice that
awaited
me my name is Andrew and I am honored to
have been one of the chosen Disciples of
Jesus Christ it was in Patra Greece
where my unwavering devotion and faith
in the Lord led me to face my martydom
the Roman soldiers numbering seven in
strength carried out their orders to
flog me
mercilessly the lashes tore through my
flesh causing unimaginable pain but I
know my suffering was but a reflection
of the suffering My Savior had endured
for the Salvation of
humanity after enduring the agonizing
torment of the whip they tied my
battered body to an x-shaped cross the
cords may have prolonged my suffering
but I find comfort in the knowledge that
I would soon be United with my Lord and
Savior in eternal
glory as I was led towards the cross an
overwhelming sense of Peace washed over
me I looked at the instrument of my
execution and instead of fear and
despair I found myself filled with
gratitude with unwavering conviction I
greeted the cross with a heartfelt
salute I have long desired and expected
this happy hour I proclaimed for the
cross had been Sanctified by the body of
Christ himself hanging on it for the
Salvation of all
Israel even in the face of excruciating
pain I refuse to allow my spirit to
waver for two days I continued to
fulfill my calling as a preacher and
disciple of Christ proclaiming his
message of love and forgiveness to my
tormentors their hearts may have been
hardened but I knew that I had been
granted this time to plant a seed of
Faith within them hoping that one day it
would bear fruit on this faithful day my
physical strength Fades and my mortal
life comes to an end as I take my final
breath my soul will rejoice at the
Eternal Embrace of my savior knowing
that my sacrifice had not been in vain
my life as an apostle had been dedicated
to sharing the good news of Jesus Christ
and spreading his teachings of Salvation
in my modom I find fulfillment in
knowing that my suffering had served a
greater purpose may my story Inspire and
encourage all those who hear it to stand
devoted and faithful to
